headlines.title: US Forces Strike Iranian Missile Launchers Near Strait of Hormuz
headlines.description: The United States and Iran are trading attacks for the first time in weeks, just days after the war reached the six-month mark. US CENTCOM says it struck Larak Island where missile launchers were preparing to deploy mines into the Strait of Hormuz. NBC’s Matt Bradley reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Urgent race to rescue survivors after flood disaster
headlines.description: An American couple who made it out alive shared video of their escape. NBC News’ Janis Mackey Frayer reports.

headlines.title: Ex-gang leader found guilty in Tupac Shakur's 1996 killing
headlines.description: A former gang leader, Duane 'Keffe D' Davis, was found guilty by a Las Vegas jury in the murder of rapper Tupac Shakur. Davis was accused of orchestrating the killing, and is the only person to ever be tried or convicted in the case. NBC News' Steve Patterson reports.

headlines.title: Justices give Trump major legal victory on ballroom project
headlines.description: A majority of Supreme Court justices ruled that construction can continue on President Trump’s White House ballroom, which also features a secure underground facility. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

headlines.title: Suspect and female victim dead after Times Square stabbing spree
headlines.description: A woman armed with at least one knife slashed two people in New York City’s Times Square before she was shot by police, according to multiple officials. NBC News’ Sam Brock reports.

headlines.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze Massachusetts primary election results
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki breaks down real-time vote tallies from primary elections in Massachusetts, while giving viewers a behind-the-scenes look at election night coverage.
